Dictionary data: JMdict_e, Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group
(EDRDG), https://www.edrdg.org/ . Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0:
https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Downloaded from https://www.edrdg.org/pub/Nihongo/JMdict_e.gz on 2026-10-05.
The derived SQLite dictionary retains this attribution and licence. Changes:
expanded spelling/reading pairs with restricted senses, indexed lookup forms,
formatted English glosses and mapped grammatical flags for lookup.

Name data: JMnedict, Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group
(EDRDG), https://www.edrdg.org/enamdict/enamdict_doc.html . CC BY-SA 4.0 under
the same EDRDG licence statement above. Downloaded from
https://www.edrdg.org/pub/Nihongo/JMnedict.xml.gz on 2026-10-06.
Changes: selected personal/place/station name categories, expanded restricted
spelling/reading pairs, English translations with name-type labels, and indexed
forms ordered behind ordinary definitions. Readings and classifications are
provided by JMnedict; ambiguous name readings are retained as alternatives.

Deinflection rules and algorithm: Yomichan Authors, copyright 2016-2022,
GPL-3.0-or-later. Rules downloaded on 2026-10-05 from:
https://github.com/FooSoft/yomichan/blob/master/ext/data/deinflect.json
Algorithm adapted from ext/js/language/deinflector.js in that repository.
Changes: Qt 5 compatible JavaScript, deduplication and bounded expansion.
See YOMICHAN-LICENSE and GPL-3.0.txt.

TranslatePen application code is GPL-3.0-or-later. Vendor firmware and extracted
PenPower resources are separate, proprietary materials, not included in this
application’s licence. Only patch scripts and independently authored code are
intended for sharing; do not redistribute the vendor executable/resources.

Optional server Japanese OCR: Manga OCR by kha-white, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/kha-white/manga-ocr
https://huggingface.co/kha-white/manga-ocr-base
Pinned model revision aa6573bd10b0d446cbf622e29c3e084914df9741.
Used locally to corroborate small kana; other characters come from the PP-OCRv5
pipeline. The model and Python dependency environment are separate build
artifacts, not embedded in the pen application.
